# Structure: ((...((...))..((...))..((...))...)))
# Outer closing: 3 pairs
# 3 hairpins each: 4-bp stem + 3-nt triloop
# 2-nt linkers between hairpins

def build_block(hp1_loop, hp2_loop, hp3_loop, closing_pairs, stem_pairs):
    '''
    closing_pairs: 3 pairs [(nt1,nt2), ...] for outer closing
    stem_pairs: list of 3 lists, each with 4 pairs for each hairpin stem
    hpX_loop: 3-nt string for each triloop
    '''
    # Outer closing (3' half will be at end)
    out_5 = ''.join(p[0] for p in reversed(closing_pairs))
    out_3 = ''.join(p[1] for p in closing_pairs)
    
    # Hairpin 1
    hp1_5 = ''.join(p[0] for p in reversed(stem_pairs[0]))
    hp1_3 = ''.join(p[1] for p in stem_pairs[0])
    hp1 = hp1_5 + hp1_loop + hp1_3 + 'AA'

    hp2_3 = ''.join(p[1] for p in stem_pairs[1])

    hp3_3 = ''.join(p[1] for p in stem_pairs[2])
    hp3 = hp3_5 + hp3_loop + hp3_3

]
